newsitem.title: USA: Ultramar to expand pipeline to Arizona mkt.
newsitem.headline: Ultramar to expand pipeline to Arizona mkt.

text.p: Ultramar Diamond Shamrock Corp's chairman and chief executive said Wednesday a 50 percent expansion of the company's El Paso pipeline is underway and expected to be finished by the end of the second quarter.

UDS chief Roger Hemminghaus also said that the company made its first delivery from the El Paso pipeline connection to the Sante Fe Pacific pipeline last week and is aiming to increase its penetration of the Arizona market.
The 10 inch pipeline, which runs for just over 400 miles from UDS's 135,000-barrel-per-day (bpd) McKee, Texas, refinery to its El Paso terminal, carries gasoline, diesel and other products.
Current pipeline capacity is 30,000 bpd, which will increase to 45,000 bpd with the addition of two pumping stations at Walcott, Texas, and Hope, New Mexico, the company said.

UDS supplies to Arizona markets 10,000 bpd of conventional gasoline and diesel through El Paso, 25,000 bpd of motor fuels from its Wilmington, Calif., plant and is prepared to supply reformulated gasoline from the McKee, Texas, plant for Arizona markets if it is required, Hemminghaus said.

"During the next year, we plan to significantly increase the volume of fuel that the company supplies to our retails and wholesale customers as we continue to grow our business in Arizona and the Western states," he added.
The company is currently building five new Corner Stores in Tuscon and Pheonix, a near 30 percent increase from the current 17. Another 17 new oulets are planned for this year.
